tools.name: search_apis
tools.description: Free-text search across the live catalogue. Matches listing name, description, category and provider name. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing.

tools.name: list_apis
tools.description: Browse the live catalogue, optionally filtered to one category. Omit category for everything. Returns settlement-verified listings only unless verified_only is false. Free and read-only; spends nothing.

tools.name: get_api
tools.description: Fetch a single live listing by its id or slug, including base_url, price range, network and verification state. payment_verified is true if at least one route was paid; verified_routes names each paid route with its on-chain receipt. Also returns a reliability object: score (0 to 100 or null), band

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_api" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Fetch a single live listing by its id or slug, including base_url, price range, network and verification state. Also returns a reliability object: score (0 to 100 or null), band (strong, established, thin, caution or unscored) and computed_at. Reliability is a running score from paid verifications, " → after: "Fetch a single live listing by its id or slug, including base_url, price range, network and verification state. payment_verified is true if at least one route was paid; verified_routes names each paid route with its on-chain receipt. Also returns a reliability object: score (0 to 100 or null), band "

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
